requiredLessons.mistakePattern: Do not treat passing source tests as deployment readiness.
requiredLessons.rootCause: Config, CI, env, release, and dependency changes can look source-only while altering release safety, cost posture, or operator evidence requirements.
requiredLessons.doNextTime: Classify the lane, reuse existing validators, update compact policy artifacts, refresh current-head release evidence, and keep provider/deploy operations separated.
requiredLessons.doNotDo: Do not grow scripts, workflows, generated artifacts, deployment commands, or provider evidence claims without owner, validator, cost, and rollback classification.
